==> scripts/bip-recent.sh <==
#!/bin/bash

# Download the file
curl --output bip-recent.zip -X 'POST' \
  'https://www.regionalstatistik.de/genesisws/rest/2020/data/tablefile' \
  -H 'accept: application/octet-stream' \
  -H "username: $REGIONALSTATISTIK_USER" \
  -H "password: $REGIONALSTATISTIK_SECRET" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -d 'regionalkey=05515&compress=false&name=82000-01-01-4&area=free&timeslices=&classifyingkey1=&classifyingkey2=&classifyingkey3=&classifyingkey4=&classifyingkey5=&stand=01.01.1970%2001%3A00&classifyingvariable1=&format=ffcsv&classifyingvariable2=&language=de&endyear=&classifyingvariable3=&transpose=false&classifyingvariable4=&contents=&classifyingvariable5=&regionalvariable=&job=false&quality=off&startyear=2022'

# Unzip the file
unzip bip-recent.zip -d bip-recent

# Move and rename the file (relative path from the root of the project)
mv bip-recent/82000-01-01-4_*.csv assets/data/bip-recent.csv

# Cleanup
rm -rf bip-recent
rm bip-recent.zip

exit 0

#!/bin/bash

# This script is used to download the CSV file from the provided URL and move it to the assets/data folder

# Download the CSV file
curl --output einwohner.zip -X 'POST' \
  "https://www.regionalstatistik.de/genesisws/rest/2020/data/tablefile" \
  -H 'accept: application/octet-stream' \
  -H "username: $REGIONALSTATISTIK_USER" \
  -H "password: $REGIONALSTATISTIK_SECRET" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -d 'name=12411-01-01-4&area=free&compress=false&transpose=false&startyear=2018&timeslices=7&regionalkey=05515&format=ffcsv&job=false&stand=01.01.1970%2001%3A00&language=de'

# Unzip the file
unzip einwohner.zip -d einwohner

# Move and rename the file (relative path from the root of the project)
mv einwohner/12411-01-01-4_*.csv assets/data/einwohner.csv

# Cleanup
rm -rf einwohner
rm einwohner.zip

# Exit the script
exit 0

#!/bin/bash

# This script is used to download the ms open data from gitlab and move it to the assets/data folder

# Download thems open data from gitlab
curl -o ms-open-data-parser-main.zip "https://gitlab.opencode.de/smart-city-muenster/klimadashboard-muenster/ms-open-data-parser/-/archive/main/ms-open-data-parser-main.zip?path=data"

unzip ms-open-data-parser-main.zip
mv ms-open-data-parser-main-data/data/* assets/data/

# Remove the .zip and extracted folder
rm -r ms-open-data-parser-main.zip ms-open-data-parser-main-data

# Exit the script
exit 0
